title: Support Specialist (Dynamics 365 Administration & Configuration)
description:
**Company Description**

Our NielsenIQ Technology teams are working on our new “Connect” platform, a unified, global, open data ecosystem powered by Microsoft Azure. Our clients around the world rely on NielsenIQ’s data and insights to innovate and grow. The Dynamics 365 Support Specialist acts as a technical SME and system administrator responsible for the support, enhancement, and governance of NielsenIQ’s internal Dynamics 365 platform. This role provides end‑user technical and data support, performs low‑code development and solution deployment, and partners with Product, Business, and Security teams to deliver compliant solutions through Agile sprints and PI planning.  
Requires the application of theoretical, technology-specific knowledge, typically gained through formal education (e.g., university or college degree), or relevant expertise in technology-related area(s) to achieve results, with an emphasis on in-depth technical knowledge, project/program management and influence skills. Majority of time is spent on: • Performing technically based activities • Contributing to and/or managing projects • Providing advice/direction in primary areas of expertise • Leveraging relationships by interfacing with and influencing key stakeholders

 **Job Description**

End User Support  
o Provide technical and functional support for Dynamics 365 users, including (but not  
limited to) forms, views, workflows, dashboards, Cases/Incidents, Contacts, Accounts,  
Leads, Users, Teams, Queues, SLAs, Business Rules, Power Automate flows, etc.  
o Partner with Product & Business to establish SME level understanding of business  
processes and documentation as it relates to end user CRM usage  
o Perform data maintenance activities (data projects, loads, corrections, extracts, etc.)  
o Diagnose and resolve data issues, integration failures, and automation errors  
o Partner with Product team to support their release communications  
o Act as a consultative partner to Product team and VOB/business users regarding best  
practices and platform usage  
o Support user licensing, access, role assignments, and environment onboarding  
o Support production instance in addition to lower environments  

* Platform Administration

o Configure and maintain Dynamics 365 entities, fields, forms, views, dashboards, flows,  
and business rules  
o Perform low-code development work, including:  

* Power Automate flows
* Light customization and extensions
* Solution packaging and deployment

o Build and maintain reports using FetchXML, SSRS (SQL Server Reporting Services), or  
Power BI (as applicable)  
o Install, configure, and maintain third‑party components and integrations  
o Support environment management and solution promotion across dev/test/prod  

* Agile Delivery, PI Planning & Deployment

o Participate in PI planning, backlog refinement, and sprint planning sessions  
contributing estimates, consultative inputs and delivery commitments  
o Estimate, design, and deliver assigned work items in coordination with product  
owners/leaders and delivery teams  
o Support business testing, QA teams, validation, and release activities  
o Partner with distributed delivery teams to execute sprint commitments  

* Platform Governance & Controls

o Ensure the Dynamics 365 and Power Platform environments operate within  
established enterprise, security, and compliance standards.  
o Apply and enforce Power Platform governance controls, including:  

* Environment strategy
* DLP (Data Loss Prevention) policies
* Solution lifecycle management

o Support SOX and internal audit requirements, including:  

* Change management evidence
* Access controls
* Segregation of duties

o Partner with architects, security and IAM teams on identity management, best  
practices, role design, and access reviews  
o Contribute to process & platform documentation, guardrails, and standards

 **Qualifications**

Required  
o 3-5 years supporting a large **Microsoft Dynamics 365 environment**.  
o **Strong troubleshooting, data analysis, and root cause skills**  
o **Hands-on experience with:**  

* **Dynamics 365 configuration and administration**

 **Power Automate (Flows); exposure to Canvas Apps**  
o Must be detail-oriented and have the ability to manage and prioritize multiple  
demands from a large user base.  
o Deep knowledge of Dynamics 365 ecosystem, data structure all technical  
and functional areas along with strong data & BI skills.  
o Understanding of Agile delivery (sprints, backlogs, PI planning)  
o Superior communication skills both written and verbal  
o Superior verbal & written communication and interpersonal skills with the  
ability to work with all levels of the organization  
o Ability to manage multiple assignments simultaneously with a high level of  
autonomy and independence  
o Ability to perform effectively with flexibility and adaptability to handle shifting  
needs, evolving priorities, and urgent situations that arise.  
o Detail orientation with strong organizational skills.  
o Ability to learn and apply new concepts quickly.  
o Ability to meet tight deadlines.  
o Demonstrated critical thinking and diagnostic skills.  

* The following experience is preferred but not required:

o Microsoft Dynamics 365 & Power Platform certifications (Preferred)  
o Experience with large Dynamics 365 Customer Service implementations  
o Experience with governance, compliance, or SOX-controlled environments  
o Experience managing CRM technology projects, including gathering and  
documenting business requirements, designing and configuring forms,  
developing workflows, reports and dashboards, and troubleshooting  
application bugs.  
o Ability to function tactically with business areas but is also comfortable with  
senior level presentations  
o Ability to help develop tech stack strategy while executing on deliverables  
What Success Looks Like  

* End users receive timely, high‑quality technical and data support
* Sprint commitments are delivered reliably and compliantly
* Power Platform solutions adhere to governance and audit standards
* The Dynamics 365 and Power Platform ecosystem is stable, secure, and

continuously improving

**Our Benefits**

* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Collaboration & Messaging (Teams & Slack)
description:
**Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (Teams & Slack)**

The Senior Enterprise Systems Engineer (Teams & Slack) is a senior technical practitioner responsible for the engineering, administration, reliability, security, and continuous improvement of enterprise messaging and productivity platforms, with a primary focus on Microsoft Teams and Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate. The role will also support and engineer the firm’s enterprise Slack environment. This is a Hybrid role and works in 2pm-11pm IST shift.

The engineer will serve as a subject matter expert for enterprise messaging, productivity, and low-code automation technologies, partnering with Digital Workplace engineering teams, Information Security, Identity & Access Management, business stakeholders, service delivery teams, and managed service partners to deliver secure, reliable, and intuitive digital workplace experiences for employees globally.

* Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise Microsoft Teams, Power Platform, and Slack environments.
* Design and maintain platform configurations, policies, standards, governance controls, integrations, and lifecycle processes.
* Serve as an advanced engineering escalation point for complex messaging and productivity platform issues.
* Investigate escalations that require advanced platform engineering expertise and perform root-cause analysis to eliminate recurring problems.
* Engineer and maintain Microsoft Teams policies including messaging, meetings, applications, external access, guest access, federation, and related capabilities.
* Engineer and support Microsoft Power Platform capabilities, with a particular focus on Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Develop and maintain Power Apps and automated workflows where appropriate to improve employee productivity and simplify repeatable business and technology processes.
* Establish and maintain Power Platform environment strategies, governance standards, security controls, application lifecycle practices, and administrative processes.
* Support Power Platform connectors, integrations, APIs, gateways, and Dataverse capabilities where applicable.

* Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Power Automate, or other appropriate technologies.
* Develop solutions that improve platform administration, reporting, provisioning, governance, lifecycle management, and operational efficiency.

* Monitor Power Platform environments, applications, flows, capacity, connectors, and related platform health.
* Evaluate Microsoft 365, Teams, Power Platform, and Slack product changes and assess potential impact and opportunities for the enterprise environment.

* Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent engineering solutions where possible.

* Recommend platform, configuration, automation, governance, or process improvements based on trends identified through escalations.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience supporting and engineering enterprise messaging, productivity, automation, or Microsoft 365 platforms, including advanced engineering experience.
* Strong hands-on experience administering and engineering Microsoft Teams in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 architecture and the relationships among Teams, Power Platform, Entra ID, and other Microsoft 365 services.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate.
* Experience designing, developing, supporting, or governing enterprise Power Apps and Power Automate solutions.
* Experience designing and implementing Teams policies, external access, guest access, federation, application controls, and governance.
* Experience with Power Platform environment management, connectors, security, application lifecycle management, and governance.
* Experience developing automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, REST APIs, Power Automate, or similar technologies.

* Experience working with enterprise security, compliance, and data-governance requirements.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex technical problems.
* Experience working within enterprise Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong technical documentation and communication skills.
* Ability to independently investigate technical issues and work across multiple technical teams to drive resolution.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Slack Enterprise Grid, enterprise applications, integrations, access controls, or platform governance.
* Microsoft 365, Teams, Power Platform, or related Microsoft certifications.

* Slack administration or Slack Certified Administrator experience/certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access.

* Experience implementing Power Platform Center of Excellence capabilities or similar enterprise governance models.

* Experience with Microsoft Purview, retention, eDiscovery, information protection, or related compliance technologies.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, tenant-to-tenant migrations, or large-scale platform migrations.
* Experience with enterprise application integrations and API-based automation.

In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. title: Demand Planning SME - o9 IBP & SOE
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible.**

You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams.

**How you will contribute**

You will:

* Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions
* Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families
* Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months)
* Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting
* Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool
* Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership

**What you will bring**

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:

* Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint
* Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment
* Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan
* Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills – and able to understand and interpret data
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis

**More about this role**

**What you need to know about this position:**

You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team.

**What extra ingredients you will bring:**

* Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing)
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role
* Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity.
* Strong attention to detail — ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies
* Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects
* Good communication skills — ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines
* Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment
* Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus

**Education / Certifications:**

Bachelor's Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience.

**Job specific requirements:**

The Demand Planning SME will serve as the BU's dedicated testing and adoption resource for the o9 Demand Planning module. Reporting into the region DP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform.

**Testing & Validation**

* Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Demand Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy
* Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams
* Perform security role validation — test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase
* Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases
* Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP
* Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks
* Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates

**Training & Change Adoption**

* Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training
* Conduct shadow testing sessions — walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence
* Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working
* Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance
* Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts

**Go-Live & Sustainment**

* Support Parallel Run execution — assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes
* Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation
* Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues
* Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning
* Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform

**Demand Analysis Support**

* High data quality management before modelling run – co-work with market planner and stakeholder to set foundation of master data, transaction and driver data.
* Closely working with data scientists to maintain the highest degree of forecast at item and planning accounts level based on industry trends and demand patterns.
* Conduct forecast review and analysis to assess demand trends, measure forecast accuracy, recommend data-driven adjustments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product lifecycle milestones, ensuring accurate demand planning for new items.
* Propose and implement forecasting improvements to enhance demand accuracy and efficiency.
* Partner with market planners to review KPIs, gather market insights, and translating market insights into actionable forecast adjustments.
* Monitor and ensure KPI metrics consistently meet business goals.
* Provide weekly performance recaps, including ASE performance reviews, root cause analysis, and action plans aligned with business operations.



No Relocation support available

Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

* Collaborate with the Planning Engineer/Team at project site for developing the construction schedulefor the respective discipline.
* Understand the requirements specified in the contract agreement of the contractors for respective discipline.
* Assist in review/approval of the Quality Plan and Inspection Test Plan of the contractors.

* Coordinate with the Contractors for submission of ‘As Built’ mark ups and review of the same

As a Recruitment Executive specializing in blue-collar hiring, you will be at the heart of our talent acquisition strategy,managing the recruitment process for high-volume roles critical to our daily operations. You will leverage your industryexpertise, network, and sourcing capabilities to attract top talent, ensuring a steady pipeline of skilled and motivatedemployees. This role is ideal for someone passionate about connecting people with opportunities and delivering results in a fast-paced, people-first organization.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Strategic Sourcing Create and execute innovative sourcing strategies tailored to blue-collar recruitment. Build strong partnerships with manpower agencies, local networks, NGOs, and community organizations to reach untapped talent pools. Utilize digital platforms, job boards, and social media to expand reach and visibility of job openings. Organize and participate in recruitment drives, walk-ins, and job fairs to attract candidates.

2. Screening and Selection Develop structured screening processes to evaluate candidates’ qualifications, experience, and suitability for specific roles. Conduct interviews that assess both technical skills and alignment with company culture. Work closely with hiring managers to understand role-specific needs and provide expert recommendations.

3. Candidate Experience Ensure a smooth and professional recruitment journey for all candidates, from application to onboarding. Communicate clearly about job expectations, work conditions, and career opportunities within the organization. Address candidate queries promptly and professionally, building a strong employer brand.

4. Process Optimization Continuously refine recruitment processes to reduce time-to-hire and improve offer-to-joining ratios. Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all recruitment activities in the database. Monitor recruitment metrics to identify trends, address bottlenecks, and propose data-driven improvements.

5. Onboarding and Retention Manage onboarding processes to ensure new hires are equipped with the tools and knowledge to succeed. Collaborate with HR and operations teams to identify opportunities for employee retention and growth.

6. Compliance and Standards Ensure all recruitment and hiring activities comply with labour laws, organizational policies, and industry standards. Stay updated on regulatory changes and implement necessary adjustments in hiring practices.

Technical Skills -

Proficiency in Applicant Tracking and other recruitment tools.

Understanding of basic labour laws and statutory compliance specific to blue-collar employment.

Preferred Qualifications -

Experience in industries such as parking management, logistics, or facilities management.

Multilingual capabilities to engage with a diverse workforce.

Certification in recruitment or HR practices would be a plus.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* End to End project Hardware design & Project engineering.
* Efficient execution of Greenfield Power & Water as well as Lump Sum Turnkey (LSTK) projects.
* Able to Read RFQ/Project specification and understand the requirements and specifications. Able to identify the risk and opportunities.

* Understanding of the project cycle, time management and production phases.
* Awareness of technical risk during project execution and site activities.
* Experience in Pre-FAT, Panel integration and Conducting customer FAT (HW) and SAT.
* Close collaboration and communication with team members located at different geographical locations, including vendors & sub-contractors.
Verification and functional testing of I/O interfaces to field devices and Supervision of control system installation, commissioning and start-up.  

**Who You Are:**

You display a can-do attitude in good and bad times. You recognize when a solution can be balanced. You focus and monitor both formal and informal progress regularly. You provide calmness and efficiency, even when things are unclear. You convert ideas into actions and produce results with new initiatives.

**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Degree in Engineering or Equivalent (Electronics & Communication, Instrumentation & Control, or equivalent field)
* 8-12 years' project engineering experience in field of DCS and some exposure to commissioning is desirable.
* DCS Hardware design exposure, Procurement exposure.
* Exposure to Project documentation and project cycles.
* In this role, you will work independently and/or as part of a team to design, implement and should have adequate experience in Hardware Engineering, Panel design and Understanding of the Network Architecture.
* You should be able to conduct project Design Review Meetings, Customer Workshops and Factory/Site Acceptance Tests with customers to demonstrate System functionality independently.
* You may need to travel about 40% of the time depending on project requirements.
* Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form.
Proficiency with ISA and SAMA logic symbols, Process & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), electrical, mechanical, and hydraulic schematics  

**Preferred Qualifications that Set You Apart:**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Problem-solving, decision-making, and planning skills
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence and commissioning documents
* Ability to optimally present information and respond to queries from management, clients, and customers.
* Proficiency with one or more DCS/PLC platforms (e.g., ABB Pro Control / Bailey INFI 90 / Symphony Harmony, Yokogawa Centum VP / CS3000, Siemens T3000 / TXP, GE Mark V / VI, Mitsubishi DIASYS Netmation, Invensys, Honeywell TDC3000, MaxDNA, MetsoDNA, Alstom Alspa320, Allen Bradley / GE-Fanuc / Schneider / Siemens PLCs & SCADA etc.)

We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Sr. Facility Manager
  
What’s your ambition? Is it a big goal or small steps? Professional or personal? We’d like to know because at JLL, we make your ambitions our business.
  
And if you have ambitions in (Workplace), join us to be inspired by the best.
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
**Job type :** Full time
  
**Reporting Manager :** Regional Head/ Account Director
  
**No of staff managed :** FM Staff & Engineering Staff
  
  
Job profile
  
  
**Qualification :** Bachelor’s / Master Degree in Hospitality, Hotel Management or Operations Management (Preferred MBA)
  
**Industry Type :** FM Services, Hotel, Projects, Construction
  
**Overall Experience :** 8 –10 years
  
**Industry Experience :** 5 – 6 years
  
**Technical Skills :** Building Services
  
**Generic Skills :** Leadership, Communication, Vendor/people management
  
**Behaviors :** Team work, Learning attitude & Positive thinking
  
  
Job Aim
  
City Lead will be responsible for managing all aspects of the facility management service delivery system at client for all sites in the city; primarily Asset Management and Operations. In this capacity, the Facility Manager is accountable for the achievement of the Management Plan and all key performance indicators including responsibility for managing the capital and expense budgets, short and long-term regional projects, operations and maintenance, interface with senior managers in client facility team and business units, coordination with other key managers within Accenture alliance partner organizations and customer satisfaction.
  
  
Competencies
  
Communication skills
  
Planning and organizational skills
  
Negotiation skills
  
Problem analysis
  
Decision-making
  
Judgment
  
Client service orientation
  
Adaptability
  
Team work
  
Presentation skills

Ensure Upkeep Schedule and Execution as per the schedules
  
Direction of daily/Weekly work at site to the staff
  
Ensure Cafeteria Management related to hygiene and food safety
  
Follow Building Inspection Plan as per the process
  
Govern Daily Walk around and Snag Closures
  
Manage Engineering Operations as per the defined SOW’s and SOPs and to ensure 100% uptime of all equipment’s present in the facility
  
Ensure Environment, Health and Safety practices
  
Managing Client/VVIP Visits and Walkthroughs
  
Managing Govt. Official Visitors
  
Delivering and adhering to the agreed KPI and SLAs
  
Ensure Incidents are managed and communicated as per the escalation matrix
  
To Ensure Builders Co-ordination on their deliverables
  
To ensure Preventive and Breakdown Maintenance (52 Weeks Planner) are adhered
  
Attending to Adhoc Requirements and to assist operations manager and Accenture leads in all F&S related internal audits and business specific external audits
  
Manage IC Requests within the TAT
  
Ensure Asset Management - Bonded and Non-bonded
  
Ensure Stores Management
  
Co-ordination with CP Team on Seat Planning
  
Project Movement (Deals) - Co-ordination
  
Supervision of Functional Areas - Reception, Helpdesk, Mailroom, Key room, BMS, Time Office, Cloak Room, Wellness, Gym, Recreation, IRC, Projector Management etc.
  
Transport Operations - Co-ordination /Events - Co-ordination /Logistics - Co-ordination
  
Govern Scrap and Waste Management
  
Conduct R&R Programs
  
Follow Business Continuity Management process
  
Ensure BGC for Direct and TPV Staff
  
Perform Daily/Weekly/Monthly checks
  
Ensure Drop Ins and Additional Power Loads are handled as per process
  
Use of Technology Tools and Operations
  
Co-ordinate - Expansions, Go Lives and Decommissioning
  
Fact Finding of abnormalities
  
Conduct Facility Risk Assessment and Mitigation

Operational requirement approvals - Photography, space blocking, Bay decoration etc.

Lead all the new Human experience initiatives at the site. Work on implementing the “WeCare program” – a JLL customer centricity program.
  
Map the key customer journey points throughout the facility and implement and manage customer experience/ delight.
  
Lead the team to bring in the ‘Wow’ experience at all High touch points within the facility and ensure all facility staff at the sites are trained to maintain the same
  
Work with the operations teams on implementing similar standards of Hospitality in all other Accenture sites.
  
Consistently achieving the KPI targets for the hospitality suite of services within budgets
  
Effective Financial, Procurement and other administrative services management for the locations under management

Fire Drill Reports are sent as per timelines

Ensure Utilities - Projection to Invoicing are done with the timelines

Ensure Non-PO Approvals are managed effectively

Ensure CCR Mock Drill are conducted as per the schedule
  
Ensure BCP Mock Drill are conducted as per the schedule

Participate in Workplace Town Halls and provide quality inputs

Ensure VOC's and CCP Survey Closures
  
  
Internal Review Programs

Ensure Monthly Management Reviews are conducted as per schedule
  
Participate in Ops Reviews and provide quality inputs
  
Provide quality inputs for Quarterly Business Reviews
  
Provide quality inputs for Half Yearly Business Reviews

To ensure support to Accenture management in ISO certifications by training and implementing ISO down the line.

Ensure Audit Participation
  
Ensure Audit Observation are closed and CAPA is done

Provide leadership to the facilities management team
  
Demonstrate leadership & responsiveness and creativity
  
Understand the FM scope and in consultations with JLL City Manager or facility manager – develop specific processes & procedures to reduce cost & improve client satisfaction
  
Accomplish at least 95% Key Performance Indicators as agreed with Accenture
  
Coordinate with City Manager / Operations Manager on the goal setting, performance reviews, and career development plan, HR related issues for facilities management team.
  
Assist City Manager in developing & implementing the facilities management account plan for the facility
  
Identify training needs for all subordinates
  
Nominate team members (Facilities & Engg.) for training conducted internally and JLL corporate team
  
Conduct 2 CEM (Critical Environment Management) Audit in a year for other facilities.
  
Participate and motivate in process improvement initiatives. Participate in CIWG.
  
On time reporting of incidents in the facility.
  
More accountable for any issues/escalation in the facility

**People Management:** Manage all the staff at the respective site in assistance with the Workplace Experience Manager and the Operations Excellence Manager at site in terms of their work supervision, Job direction and career management.

**Learning & Development:** Work with the HRBP to periodically assess the learning and Development needs for the Engineering staff at site and ensure appropriate Trainings / Certifications are carried out.

Ensure TPV Staff On-boarding and Training
  
Ensure Cafe Staff Training and other vendor partners
  
Ensure Floor Warden Training prior to Fire Drill
  
Ensure TPV Fire Safety Training prior to Fire Drill

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
